title: Reject invalid quantity boundaries
objective: Confirm that quantities immediately outside the permitted range are rejected without changing the existing quantity.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in DRAFT state.
An order line has an existing quantity of 5.

test_data.name: invalid boundary quantities
test_data.description: Values 0 and 11, immediately outside the inclusive range 1 through 10.

steps.action: Set the order-line quantity to the value specified by the current subtest and submit the change.
steps.expected_result: The value is rejected and the existing quantity remains 5.

subtests.title: Below minimum
subtests.expected_result: The value is rejected and the existing quantity remains 5.

subtests.title: Above maximum
subtests.expected_result: The value is rejected and the existing quantity remains 5.

notes: No rejection message is asserted because ORD-002 does not specify one.
